trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy first — all 54 of them. There is no shortcut: finish the story, reach 100% completion, and clear every activity and collectible in this guide. The roadmap below orders the whole hunt; expect around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and unlocks as the story begins — just play through the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you do, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears after this chapter. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Most of the list opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable, so use this chapter to start activities, races and collectibles alongside the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back for anything chapter-bound.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back for anything chapter-bound.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save before it — there is no mission replay, so a save lets you go back for anything tied to the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story missions unlock in order — play through the story and this one comes to you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist tracks it — finish the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges. This is the longest trophy in the list and the last one most players earn before the platinum; budget around 200 hours for the full hunt.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts count whenever you land jumps, near-misses and air time while driving — chain them on open roads and ramps around Leonida and the count climbs steadily. It is a grind, not a skill test, so fold it into your normal driving.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type the game offers. Sample one of everything — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, the shooting range, bowling, a drone race, meditation, hunting and a stunt — and the trophy pops. Use it as a checklist for what the game offers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range and hit gold on each — steady aim beats speed, and you can retry a challenge as often as you like.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 in all. Learn each short course, then win it; the races are short, so retrying a lost one costs little.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road races, drone races and any other race type — so vary the events rather than repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line beats rushing it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, play a game through to the end, and it counts — pick the shortest game on offer.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger strands unlock as you explore — take Andy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Stranger strands unlock as you explore — take Kenton's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Stranger strands unlock as you explore — take Billy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear with a marker on the map — take their missions when you see them and finish each strand; eight completed strands earns the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Stranger strands unlock as you explore — take Randy's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Stranger strands unlock as you explore — take Tyrone's missions when they appear and follow the strand to its end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and do the Chapter 1 spot, Lucia's balcony, before Chapter 1 ends. It disappears after the chapter and there is no mission replay, so this is the list's only missable trophy. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting work, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down — use the hunting tools the game gives you and approach quietly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets, and three completed sets earns the silver. Check each set's progress as you go so you know which cards are still missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK activity at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each new location counts once — spread it across your exploration rather than repeating one spot.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives scattered through activities and the world — finish any 50 and the trophy pops; the counter tracks your progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the heat up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Do it while a partner is available — partner availability changes with the story.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan a route with shops close together and keep moving. Do it while a partner is available.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new and it counts toward the 100 — new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft you get into all add up, so hop into anything you have not driven before.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends — pick a crowded fight and aim for clustered targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Leave the airport by air on your own terms rather than through the normal departures — the description is deliberately vague, and the trophy pops when you take a plane out without going through the schedule.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the game's tanks. The description is the whole hint. Find a Rhino in the world or in a high wanted-level response and deal with it; the community is still pinning down the most reliable spawn, so check the sources below for the latest reports.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case a jewelry store, get in and out without raising the alarm — go quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before anyone notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan the escape route before you go in, and do not linger after the vault opens.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away — a quiet stretch of road and a fast getaway car help.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited — cover the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the keys, and the trophy pops when the last area is found.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. Hit one illegal operation for each of them. The map and your contacts point to gang operations; work through the list gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail — a quiet moment, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash, done in style.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Find the alley, start a game and play it through to the end — the follow-through is the point.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it is tied to a partnership moment in the game. The community is still pinning down the exact trigger, so check the sources below for the latest reports.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one — the choices you make across the game add up, so play naturally and make decisions when the game offers them; the count climbs as you go.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy rewards the retry. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community; check the sources below for the latest reports.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in the world — Leonida hides odd events for players who explore. The community is still mapping the exact trigger; check the sources below for the latest reports.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to launder, and the total counts toward $250,000. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering as you rob.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and anything else the shops sell — the total counts across every shop, so normal spending across the game gets you most of the way there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property on offer — eight in all — and the trophy pops. Save up; properties are the big purchases in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Put ten vehicles you own or find onto the Scooter Bros app — each registered vehicle counts once, so register as you collect.
